base: PhysicalHeightInterfaceV2 at the unchanged H2c/H2d primary H_A=.0065; not the H2d optimized seed
physical_problem: unchanged calibrated h_s, reference fit/us/nu, AnalyticalNeutralInflowV1, Regularized beta=.4 Gamma=1 gamma0=0, Linear inner stress, budget cutoff, open boundaries, IMEX1 one sweep, 3000 slots

velocity_basis.conditioning: symmetric physical consistent-mass Gram eigendecomposition; retain eigenvalues > 1e-10 times maximum
velocity_basis.trust_metric: Euclidean norm in mass-orthonormal coordinates, equal to physical velocity L2

velocity_constraints.interpretation: same H2d fixed nominal flat-volume/Uhill scale: .15*.8; actual curved-volume-normalized departures reported too
velocity_constraints.response_caps: active/nearly active rows included in every local subproblem; full trial inventory checked
velocity_constraints.strong_divergence_limit: native physical-volume GL16 base L2*(1+1e-6)+1e-9; independent GL20 final check within 1e-8 absolute
velocity_constraints.weak_continuity: preserve native homogeneous Q constraints independently
velocity_constraints.roof: no extra essential condition; soft roof streamwise-gradient penalty, roof W=0 remains physical essential boundary

scalar_basis.shape: base scalar times smooth Gaussian x function and (zHat-H)^2*exp(-(zHat-H)/height), projected into native outer support and exact zero inlet/interface rows
scalar_basis.conditioning: relative-field physical-volume mass Gram, same 1e-10 rank threshold
scalar_basis.fixed: all inner k, endpoint K/interface/inlet scalar coefficients, all prescribed rows, pressure/reference data

objective.nature: nonconvex phase I; linearized eigenvalue constraints plus slack are only local subproblems

accounting.stagnation: six iterations without >=1e-5 improvement in the true normalized covariance deficit, or trust radius below 1e-6

certification.runtime: certified executable/closure or exact-state revalidation and fresh certificate

flat_task: read-only assembly/representation plan using retained H2d evidence; no evolving knot sweep or guard change
